goal: density, Tg and bulk modulus for poly(methyl methacrylate) (isotactic), stereo_r2

evidence.claim: polymer_rules.json:classes.PACR.ff_note: PCFF via EMC (build-tested: PMMA PASS). GAFF/GAFF2 (Class I) was rejected: NkepsuMbitou2025 reports >45% Tg error for PMMA under GAFF vs <10% under PCFF. An unresolved discrepancy remains open: the same review's <2% Class-II density figure for PMMA is 3-4x smaller than PolyJarvis's own measured -5.7% to -6.6% PCFF density deficit; a dedicated search for a tacticity/DP/charge-method mechanism found nothing. Treat PACR density as this class's known-weakest/lowest-confidence property; no field-override recommended.
High-throughput GAFF2 polymer MD; 1 ns NVT anneal 300→700 K; 10 chains ~10,000 atoms; LAMMPS; systematic Tg and density for 1070+ polymers. Primary reference for nchain, dp, and forcefield defaults.
evidence.citation: Hayashi, Y. et al. RadonPy: Automated Physical Property Calculation using All-atom Classical Molecular Dynamics Simulations for Polymer Informatics. npj Comput. Mater. 2022, 8, 222.

evidence.claim: Definitive protocol comparison: stepwise vs continuous cooling, temperature ranges, cooling rates for polymer electrolytes. Protocol: 40-540 K sweep, 20 K steps, 2 ns eq + 2 ns prod per step.
evidence.citation: Webb, M. A. et al. How to Determine Glass Transition Temperature of Polymer Electrolytes from Molecular Dynamics Simulations. J. Phys. Chem. B 2024, 128, 49, 11978–11991.

evidence.claim: OPLS3e GPU-based Tg for 315 polymers; validates electrostatics impact on polar vs apolar polymers. lj/cut acceptable only when backbone charge < 0.1 e.
evidence.citation: Afzal, M. A. F. et al. High-Throughput Molecular Dynamics Simulations and Validation of Thermophysical Properties of Polymers for Various Applications. ACS Appl. Polym. Mater. 2021, 3, 2, 620–630.

evidence.claim: Systematic review of Class I (GAFF2, OPLS-AA) and Class II (PCFF, CVFF) all-atom FFs for PMMA (PACR) and PIB/polyisobutylene (PHYC); benchmarks thermomechanical properties against experiment. Class II FFs outperform Class I for thermomechanical predictions; informs PACR and PHYC FF confidence notes.
evidence.citation: Nkepsu Mbitou, R. L.; Bedoui, F. A Review on All-Atom Force Fields Capabilities to Predict Polymer Properties: Case of Poly(methyl methacrylate) and Polyisobutylene Polymer Systems. Comput. Mater. Sci. 2025, 253, 113861.

evidence.claim: AA-MD glass-transition/dynamics study of polycarbonate (PC) and PMMA via cooling simulations (Tg, radius of gyration, dihedral transitions, end effects, INM). IMPORTANT: PC uses the Kremer et al. force field and PMMA uses OPLS-AA — NEITHER is PCFF. It validates that AA-MD reproduces PC/PMMA Tg & Rg; it does NOT validate PCFF and does NOT benchmark mass density. Do not cite as a PCFF or density source. The 'PCFF PMMA density within 2%' result is NkepsuMbitou2025 (10.1016/j.commatsci.2025.113861, Fig 4 / §5.1).
evidence.citation: Tang, Z.; Okazaki, S. All-Atomistic Molecular Dynamics Study of the Glass Transition of Amorphous Polymers. Polymer 2022, 254, 125044.

entanglement_dp_advisory.detail: entanglement MW Me=12500 g/mol for member 'PMMA' (Mark 2007 Ch.25) / repeat-unit MW 100.1 g/mol -> DP@Me=125 -- reported for context only, not an acceptance criterion for bulk_modulus: entanglement Me governs shear/viscoelastic properties (plateau modulus, reptation), not the isothermal bulk modulus, which is an EOS/local-packing quantity. Establish chain-length convergence of density/K instead (a small DP sweep confirming both plateau) rather than requiring DP>=DP@Me.

nchain_below_production_minimum.detail: nchain=10 is below the advisory PCFF production minimum 20. Its source ("Bejagam 2020") has no copy in this repo and no verified DOI, so the claim is unchecked; nchain>=10 (Wang 2021, verified) IS met, and Hayashi 2022 (RadonPy) ran nchain=10 across 1,077 polymers. Raising nchain to 20 at a fixed system-mass floor would halve per-chain MW (worse chain-length bias); raising it at fixed DP doubles cost for no criterion this module can state. Reported, not applied -- the L>=2*Rg finite-size gate (a separate, already-mechanized check) is the binding constraint on nchain; supply a nchain is now a pure function of the system-mass floor.
